description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * kernel: mm/damon/ops-common: handle extreme intervals in damon_hot_score() (CVE-2026-64458)
  * kernel: crypto: ecc - Fix carry overflow in vli multiplication (CVE-2026-64313)
  * kernel: ALSA: usx2y: us144mkii: fix work UAF on disconnect (CVE-2026-64491)
  * kernel: Bluetooth: bpa10x: avoid OOB read of revision string in bpa10x_setup() (CVE-2026-64549)
  * kernel: fscrypt: Add missing superblock check in find_or_insert_direct_key() (CVE-2026-68148)
  * kernel: sunrpc: harden rq_procinfo lifecycle to prevent double-free (CVE-2026-72220)
  * kernel: selinux: avoid sk_socket dereference in selinux_sctp_bind_connect() (CVE-2026-72242)
  * kernel: net: ipip: require CAP_NET_ADMIN in the device netns for changelink (CVE-2026-72053)
  * kernel: scsi: target: Bound PR-OUT TransportID parsing to the received buffer (CVE-2026-72084)
  * kernel: RDMA/bnxt_re: Free SRQ toggle page after firmware teardown (CVE-2026-72500)
  * kernel: NFSD: Handle layout stid in nfsd4_drop_revoked_stid() (CVE-2026-74316)
  * kernel: RDMA/bnxt_re: Free CQ toggle page after firmware teardown (CVE-2026-72499)
  * kernel: perf/core: Fix group leader use-after-free after sibling detach (CVE-2026-74637)
  * kernel: sunrpc: defer rq_argp and rq_resp free until after RCU grace period (CVE-2026-89545)
  * kernel: nfsd: RCU-protect cl_cb_session to fix use-after-free on session teardown (CVE-2026-89708)
  * kernel: nfsd: validate sockaddr length per family in listener_set (CVE-2026-89700)
  * kernel: NFSD: check truncate permission under inode lock (CVE-2026-89713)
  * kernel: NFSv4/pnfs: key the data server cache on the NFS version (CVE-2026-90102)
  * kernel: arm64: ptrace: Keep 'orig_x0' in-sync with x0 on syscall entry (CVE-2026-90347)
  * kernel: Bluetooth: hci_conn: fix the SCO setup context lifetime (CVE-2026-90255)
  * kernel: RDMA/bnxt_re: Clear VM_MAYWRITE on DBR/toggle page mmap (CVE-2026-92495)
  * kernel: nfsd: convert nfsd_net boolean flags to unsigned long flags word (CVE-2026-93221)
  * kernel: svcrdma: Fix unmatched rn_unregister on failed accept (CVE-2026-93224)
  * kernel: i3c: master: Fix device_register() error path (CVE-2026-93283)
  * kernel: vxlan: mdb: Fix use-after-free in vxlan_mdb_flush() (CVE-2026-93250)
  * kernel: btrfs: fix use-after-free on reloc root after error in insert_dirty_subvol() (CVE-2026-93800)
  * kernel: btrfs: tree-checker: validate names in ROOT_REF and ROOT_BACKREF (CVE-2026-97415)
  * kernel: btrfs: tree-checker: validate INODE_REF's namelen (CVE-2026-93813)
  * kernel: scsi: qla2xxx: Unlink NVMe unsol ctx before freeing on LS reject error (CVE-2026-97528)
  * kernel: kernel: arbitrary code execution via out-of-bounds stack access in scsi_cdl_enable() (CVE-2026-98232)
  * kernel: futex: Also allocate private hash on vfork() (CVE-2026-98281)
  * kernel: tcp: prevent collapsing skbs across boundary in rtx queue (CVE-2026-98549)
  * sandboxed-containers: kernel: systemd-gpt-auto-generator: Guest Data Leakage in Confidential Computing (Sandboxed Containers) (CVE-2026-121876)
  * kernel: cipso: adjust cached option offsets when removing CIPSO (CVE-2026-99064)
  * kernel: net/sched: fix use-after-free in __tcf_action_put() (CVE-2026-99167)
  * kernel: kernel: Privilege escalation via reference counter wrap in io_uring (CVE-2026-99227)
  * kernel: kernel: Denial of Service via race condition in TCP socket lookup (CVE-2026-99288)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * [rhel-10.3.z]Booting slowdown / soft lockups when booting VM with large GPU BAR [rhel-10.3.z] (JIRA:RHEL-253945)
  * backport 2 virtio-net big packet commits, to fix severe performance degration regression [rhel-10.3.z] (JIRA:RHEL-255941)
  * Fix pending kernel issues for L1VH GA - Kernel [rhel-10.3.z] (JIRA:RHEL-274964)
  * Critical Bug Fixes for customer issues with lpfc [rhel-10.3.z] (JIRA:RHEL-286168)
  * [RHEL-10.3.z] RDMA/bnxt_re: Backport security fixes (JIRA:RHEL-300139)
  * [AlmaLinux 10.3] drm/ttm: Bump TTM_NUM_MEM_TYPES to 10 (JIRA:RHEL-307271)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
